newsitem.title: USA: JonBenet murder may not be tied to sex assault-paper.
newsitem.headline: JonBenet murder may not be tied to sex assault-paper.

text.p: Police are looking into the possibility that sexual assault may not have been a factor in the murder of six-year-old beauty pageant winner JonBenet Ramsey, a published report said on Wednesday.

The Rocky Mountain News reported that investigators were examining an alternative theory that the child was the victim of a deadly physical attack not motivated by sex and which did not include sexual abuse.
The child's body was found on Dec. 26 by her father in the basement of the family's home in Boulder, Colo., about eight hours after her mother said she found a ransom note demanding $118,000.
Boulder spokesman Kelvin McNeill said police had no comment on the published report. "Such speculation does not serve the process of justice," he said.
The Rocky Mountain News article said investigators were not ruling out the possibility of a sexual assault but were also checking other angles.
No arrests have been made and no suspects named in the 13-week-old probe.
The newspaper also said medical experts believe there could be non-sexual explanations for the chronic inflammation found in the girl's vaginal region that was listed in her autopsy report.
Police have never disclosed whether the murder involved sexual assault.
